tools.name: get_results
tools.description: The 2026 Knesset result: seats and votes of every list, the 3.25% threshold, the blocs (editorial mapping) and the count status (preliminary until the CEC publishes the official result).

tools.name: find_town
tools.description: How a town, village or kibbutz voted (regular ballot boxes): vote shares, the Knesset Israel would elect if it voted the same way, the town that voted most like it, its CBS socio-economic cluster, and the list that came first there in every Knesset election since 2003 (CEC final results). Search by

tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: Where forming the government stands: the stage, the factions’ confirmed recommendations to the President (each confirmed by two independent sources), the mandate and its deadline.

tools.name: check_coalition
tools.description: Seats of a set of parties and whether they reach 61, with every red line the coalition would cross: pairs of its parties where one publicly ruled the other out, with the quotes and sources. A logic aid, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_what_can_change
tools.description: How far the result is from changing (votes for a seat to change blocs, each bloc’s distance to 61, each list’s nearest seat each way) and the tracked complaints, inquiries, cases and appeals, with their status and sources.

tools.name: get_wealth_and_vote
tools.description: The vote of Israel’s municipalities grouped by their CBS socio-economic cluster (index 2021, pairs 1–2 … 9–10): each bloc’s share of the valid votes. Describes places, not voters.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: The latest posts of the site’s feed: party leaders, the President and political journalists, chosen by a published rule, machine-translated where marked.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_news · Public sink: get_wealth_and_vote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_news · Public sink: get_wealth_and_vote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_town" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
